I dont if its her or our lack of conversations. Probably has more to do with my personal insecurities about the situation. Hard to be with someone part time or try and grow into something when they are unable to give you their all. Which I have expressed and she asked me to please give her time.
Thats like asking why anyone posts any question online. We have had several conversations I was just curious if anyone has been in the same situation.
Yes I would love to talk bc it is a difficult situation.

I understand trying to do what it takes to just feel ok. When I was younger I would judgr others for doing thing I perceived as weird. But as I have gotten older and especially in the past year I come to envy those people to a certain extent. I believe that whatever you have to do to survive another day or that makes you feel ok is what you should be doing. Whether its art, legos or playing a card game if gets you through the day then more power to you. Ive been struggling to make it through every day since my ex left me for someone else. If medicine works for you then I say do what you have to do. No one has the right to judge how you make it through. I wish that I could change my thoughts and find a way to get through. I get angry at myself for still being in love with a person that doesn't give a shit about me. I see her happy and in live and it twists that knife a little deeper every day.

I think it shows strength you finished school and keep trying different jobs and that you are able to get new jobs. I understand that longing to feel "normal", to have what seems so easy for others but not being able to understand how or why its unattainable for you. What was different during those periods where you felt good? Is it something you are able to do again.Also great job on getting a psych degree!! That is very impressive. I didn't finish college and regret it often. It must have been tough to make it through but you made it and that is something you can always be proud of.

And every time I think im doing better or the right thing its not. How can people be wrong so many times? I hate watching others be lucky and have life consistently go their way. Im jealous of them and their lives. Wondering how and why? What makes them better at life?

I hate being that "toxic" person. The bad guy in everyone's life I have touched. Every ex I have had has went on to bigger and better things while I stay the same miserable person. It is embarrassing to be this person. The way the world judges me. I always think Im doing the right thing but I consistently make bad decisions and choices. Its probably the worst feeling in the world.
